LockHold.desc: The corresponding lock `{lock}` is held for the duration of lifetime '`{a}`.

NonData_race.desc: The memory block `{loc}` should not have data races.

NonDropped.desc: The value `{val}` is not dropped when it is used in the context of `{event}`.

NonMutate.desc: When value `{val}` is alive, the memory pointed at by `{ptr}` must not be mutated.

NonZero.desc: The value `{val}` remains non-zero for the duration of the lifetime `{a}`.

NonMutRef.desc: There is no mutable reference to `{val}` created.

NonConcurrent.desc: The value `{val}` should not be accessed concurrently by multiple users.

NonUsed.desc: This value `{val}` must not be used as an argument in any other function.

NonAccessable.desc: The pointee of `{ptr}` must not be accessed after this call.

NonInstance.desc: For the duration of the lifetime '{a}', there must not exist a value '{val}'.

Valid.desc: The value `{val}` must be valid for the duration of `{a}`.

ValidWrite.desc: The pointer `{dst}` is valid for writing `{len}` bytes.

ValidRead.desc: The pointer `{src}` is valid for reading `{len}` bytes.

MayInvalid.desc: The value `{v}` may become invalid during later usage.

ValidVma.desc: The VMA `{v}` must be valid for the duration of '`{l}`.

ValidFile.desc: The pointer `{f}` must point to a valid file.

ValidMemory.desc: The address `{addr}` is the start of a valid memory region of size `{s}`.

ValidCast.desc: The pointer of type `{U}` can be castbale to type `{T}` ,  and any value of type `{T}` written through such a pointer must result in a valid value.

ValidInstance.desc: The value`{v}` must be a valid instance for usage.

CalledBy.desc: This function is only called by the specified environment `{env}`.

CallOnce.desc: This function can only be called once.

PostToFunc.desc: The function taged by this property can only be called after `{fn}` has been called.

OriginateFrom.desc: The value `{val}` is returned by a call to function `{fn}`.

AnyThread.desc: Function `{fn}` can be called from any thread.

CurThread.desc: The argument `{input}` can only be called or accessed on the current thread.

RefTransfer.desc: The caller must own a refcount on `{ptr}` that is transferred to the returned `{ret}`.

Invariant.desc: The type invariants for `*{ptr}` must hold for the pointee of `{ptr}`.

ActiveContext.desc: The returned object is only used to access `{val}` within the task context that was active when this function was called.

Associated.desc: The value `{val}` is associated with a value of type `{T}`.

ContainerOf.desc: The pointer `{p}` points at a field `{f}` of container `{C}`.

FlagSet.desc: The flag `{flag}` must already have been set.

InList.desc: The value {val} must be in list `{list}`.

NonInList.desc: The value {val} must not be in the list `{list}`.

Equal.desc: The left val `{l}` must be equal to the right val `{r}`.

NonExist.desc: An instance of type `{T}` must not exist for value '{val}'.

Think_Exist.desc: The tracking inside `{type}` must think that there is a `{target}` reference.

Access.desc: The caller must have `{type}` access to `{T}` for the duration of `{ret_val}`.
